text: Everything vibrates. Every frequency has a voice. I listen to them all—a symphony no one else can hear. But the symphony is becoming discordant.
These entities have frequencies too. But theirs is harsh, uncontrolled. They're drowning out the music. Someone needs to restore harmony.
With each one I still, the chord grows clearer. But there's an underlying rhythm. Something deeper calling. I must answer it.
The resonance intensifies. The music here is more complex, more layered. It requires greater skill to harmonize with it.
This entity vibrates with purpose. Its frequency is almost... intelligent. We resonate on similar wavelengths. It understands the music.
I'm learning the song now. Each victory teaches me a new note. The melody becomes clearer with every silence I create.
The apex of the song. All frequencies converge into a single, piercing note. It's beautiful and terrible and true.
The composer. The one who wrote this symphony. I finally meet the voice I've been hearing in every frequency since I was born.
I understand now. I'm not just listening—I'm part of the composition. My voice matters. My frequency shapes the song.
The final note. We resonate together in perfect harmony. And in that moment, I know: the symphony was never meant to be heard. It was meant to be completed.
